laws.rule: Since 1 October 2024 Shibuya Ward bans drinking on streets, in parks and other public places in the designated area around Shibuya Station from 6 pm to 5 am every day of the year.
laws.heading: 渋谷駅周辺地域の安全で安心な環境の確保に関する条例 (amended, in force October 2024)

laws.rule: Tokyo Metropolitan accommodation tax, collected by hotels and ryokan: JPY 100 a person a night for room rates of JPY 10,000 to 14,999 (about A$0.90), JPY 200 from JPY 15,000 (about A$1.80); none under JPY 10,000 (about A$90.24) (RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = JPY 110.82). From stays on 1 April 2027 it becomes 3% of the room-only rate, with no tax under JPY 13,000 (about A$117.31), and also applies to simple lodgings and minpaku (private home stays).
laws.heading: 宿泊税 (Tokyo Metropolitan Government)

laws.rule: Chiyoda Ward (Tokyo Station, Marunouchi, Akihabara, Kanda) bans smoking on every street in the ward and in listed parks; smokers must use designated smoking areas. Wardens collect a JPY 2,000 penalty (about A$18.05, RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = JPY 110.82). The ward has applied it to heated tobacco since November 2024.
